「何を悠長にやっている」
と。
俺が蹴破った窓から、外套をはためかせて言峰が飛び込んできた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“What are you dawdling around for?”

—And with that, Kirei comes flying in through the window I kicked out, his coat flaring behind him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What are you waiting for?”
Then.
Kotomine jumps in through the window I broke.

pages.ja:
「コトミネ……！？」
俺から手を離して、バッと身構えるイリヤ。
pages.jaRuby:
「コトミネ……！？」
俺から手を離して、バッと身構えるイリヤ。
pages.en:
“Kotomine…!?”

Illya lets go of my hand and springs back into a defensive stance.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Kotomine…!?”
Illya pulls her hand from mine and stands on guard.

pages.ja:
「あ、待ったイリヤ……！ そいつは味方だ。今回だけ協力する事になった、即興の味方なんだ」
「え！？ うそ、シロウったらこんなヤツと手を組んだの！？ ダメよシロウ、こいつは」
「無駄話は後だ。追いつかれる前に外に出るぞ」
「え、きゃっ
！？」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Ah, wait, Illya…! He’s on our side. Just this once, we agreed to work together. He’s an ally we picked up on the fly.”

“What!? Shirou, you teamed up with *him*!? No, Shirou, you can’t! He’s—”

“Save the chatter for later. We’re getting outside before they catch up.”

“Huh—eep!?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, wait, Illya…! He’s on our side. We’re cooperating just this once. We made a quick team.”
“What!? No way, you’re working with this guy!? Shirou, you can’t, he…”
“We can talk later. Let’s go outside before they catch up to us.”
“Eh, kya
!?”

pages.ja:
一瞬の早業。
言峰はイリヤの腕を掴むと、そのまま、躊躇する事なく窓から外へ飛び出していた。
pages.jaRuby:
一瞬の早業。
言峰はイリヤの腕を掴むと、そのまま、躊躇する事なく窓から外へ飛び出していた。
pages.en:
—It happens in a flash.

Kirei seizes Illya by the arm and, without the slightest hesitation, leaps straight out the window with her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
He moves in an instant.
Kotomine grabs Illya’s arm and jumps out the window without any hesitation.

pages.ja:
「な
イリヤ…………！！！！」
慌てて窓に飛びつく。
pages.jaRuby:
「な
イリヤ…………！！！！」
慌てて窓に飛びつく。
pages.en:
“Wh—Illya…………!!!!”

I scramble to the window.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Wha
Illya……!!!!”
I dash to the window.

pages.ja:
……言峰は庭に着地している。
言峰に抱かれたまま地上に降りたイリヤは、
そのあとすぐさま手を振り払って、バチン、と神父の頬を叩いていた。
……ここまで聞こえてくるんだから、実にいい音をさせている。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
…Kirei has landed in the garden.

Illya reaches the ground still in his arms, then immediately tears herself free and—smack—slaps the priest across the cheek.

…It carries all the way up here. That was one hell of a clean smack.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Kotomine has already landed.
Illya is in his arms.
At once, she shakes off his grip and slaps his face.
…She hit him so hard that I can hear it from up here.

pages.ja:
「っ
感心してる場合じゃない、要するに飛び降りろって事かよあいつ……！」
迷っている暇はない。
三階程度の高さならうまく着地すればなんとかなる。
pages.jaRuby:
「っ
感心してる場合じゃない、要するに飛び降りろって事かよあいつ……！」
迷っている暇はない。
三階程度の高さならうまく着地すればなんとかなる。
pages.en:
“—This is no time to be impressed. So basically he expects me to jump too…!?”

There’s no time to hesitate.

From about the third floor, I should be able to manage if I land right.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
This isn’t the time to be amazed. So he wants me to jump…!?”
There’s no time to hesitate.
I can manage this height if I land properly.

pages.ja:
「ふ
」
出来るだけの魔力を両足に帯電させる。
自分の体に“強化”はかけられないが、これなら少しは落下の衝撃を軽減でき
pages.jaRuby:
「ふ
」

pages.en:
“Hnh—”

I charge both legs with as much magical energy as I can manage.

I can’t use Reinforcement on my own body, but this should at least soften the impact when I land—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Fuh
”
I charge as much magical energy as I can into my feet.
I can’t strengthen my own body, but this should soften the landing

pages.ja:
るワケないだろバカーーーーー！
「っ
ぅううううう……！！！！」
二十メートル強の高さを飛び降り、着地の瞬間にごろんごろんと回転する。
三階とはいえ、城の三階はとんでもなく高かったのだ。
日本の建物なら、間違いなく八階相当の落下である。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
——Like hell it will, you idiooooooot!

“——Ghhhhhh…!!!!”

I jump from a height of just over twenty meters and hit the ground rolling, tumbling over and over the instant I land.

It may only be the third floor, but the stories in this castle are absurdly tall.

In a Japanese apartment building, that would unquestionably be an eight-story fall.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Or not!!!!!
“
Uhhhhhh…!!!!”
I jump down twenty meters and roll the instant I hit the ground.
It’s only the third floor, but the third floor of a castle is very high up.
In a normal house, it’d be somewhere around the eighth story.

pages.ja:
「効いたぁ……脳天飛び出すかと思ったぞ、今の」
……くそ、足が痺れて立ち上がれない。
それでも下が芝生だったのが幸いした。
これがアスファルトだったら足の骨に罅でも入って、ここから逃げ出す事ができなくなっている。
pages.jaRuby:
「効いたぁ……脳天飛び出すかと思ったぞ、今の」
……くそ、足が痺れて立ち上がれない。
それでも下が芝生だったのが幸いした。
これがアスファルトだったら足の骨に罅でも入って、ここから逃げ出す事ができなくなっている。
pages.en:
“That hurt… I thought the top of my head was going to fly off.”

…Damn it. My legs are too numb to stand.

Still, I was lucky there was grass under me.

If that had been asphalt, I might have cracked a bone in my leg and been unable to get out of here at all.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That hurts… I thought my brain would pop out.”
…Damn, my feet are so numb that I can’t even stand.
But I’m lucky that it’s grassy here.
If this were asphalt, I would’ve broken my legs, and then I’d never be able to escape.

pages.ja:
「びっくり。シロウ、丈夫だね」
「そうだな。あの高さから何の魔術行使もなしに落下とは恐れ入る。
自棄か？」
まじまじと倒れた俺を眺める二人。
イリヤはともかく、言峰の言い分は足の痺れを忘れさせるほどアレだった。
pages.jaRuby:
「びっくり。シロウ、丈夫だね」

自棄か？」
まじまじと倒れた俺を眺める二人。
イリヤはともかく、言峰の言い分は足の痺れを忘れさせるほどアレだった。
pages.en:
“Wow. Shirou, you’re really tough.”

“Indeed. I am impressed that you would fall from such a height without using any magecraft at all. Was that sheer desperation?”

The two of them stare down at me where I lie.

Illya’s comment is one thing. Kirei’s is so outrageous it makes me forget the numbness in my legs.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I’m surprised. You’re tough, Shirou.”
“Indeed. It is amazing that you jumped from that height without using any magic.
Are you suicidal?”
The two stare at me.
Setting Illya aside for the moment, Kotomine’s comment makes me forget about the pain.

pages.ja: 「っざけんな、おまえが飛び降りたからああするしかなかったんだよ！ 俺だってこんなのは二度とゴメンだ、ふつう足折れてるし飛び降りた瞬間なんて目眩で失神しかけたんだからなっ！」
pages.jaRuby: 「っざけんな、おまえが飛び降りたからああするしかなかったんだよ！ 俺だってこんなのは二度とゴメンだ、ふつう足折れてるし飛び降りた瞬間なんて目眩で失神しかけたんだからなっ！」
pages.en: “Don’t give me that! You jumped, so what else was I supposed to do!? I never want to do that again. Normally your legs would break, and the instant I jumped I nearly passed out from vertigo!”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Shut up! I had to do it because you jumped! I don’t want to do this ever again! You’d normally break your leg, and I almost fainted right when I started the jump!”

pages.ja:
「だが五体満足ではないか。文句を言われる筋合いはないが……しかし、確かに驚きだ。よくあの高さから飛び降りよう、などと思えたな。
いかに魔術師とはいえ、魔術行使なしで飛び降りようとは思うまいに」
pages.jaRuby:
「だが五体満足ではないか。文句を言われる筋合いはないが……しかし、確かに驚きだ。よくあの高さから飛び降りよう、などと思えたな。
いかに魔術師とはいえ、魔術行使なしで飛び降りようとは思うまいに」
pages.en:
“And yet you remain entirely intact. You have no grounds for complaint. …Still, I admit I am surprised. I cannot imagine what made you think you could jump from that height.

“Even a mage would hardly consider such a descent without using magecraft.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But you have no injuries. You have no right to complain… But it is certainly a surprise. Why did you even consider jumping from that height?
Even a magus would not think about jumping from that height without using a spell.”

」

pages.en:
“What—?”

But they left me behind, and Kirei made the jump while carrying Illya. If I didn’t follow after that, it would have looked pathetic, or—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Eh
”
Well, I was left behind, and since Kotomine jumped with Illya, I thought I’d look bad if I didn’t do it too

pages.ja:
「シロウのせいじゃないわ。シロウは体だけじゃなくて、精神までアーチャーの影響を受けているのよ。
だから体だって丈夫になってるし、あの高さなら降りられるって、アーチャーと同じように思っちゃったのよ」

pages.en:
“It isn’t Shirou’s fault. Archer is affecting more than Shirou’s body. He’s affecting his mind too.

“That’s why your body has gotten tougher, and why you thought, just as Archer would, that you could get down safely from that height.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It’s not Shirou’s fault. Archer’s influencing his mind as well as his body.
That’s why his body’s so tough. He thought he could handle that drop the way Archer could.”

pages.ja:
「……え？ イリヤ、今の、どういう」
「なるほど、それは頼もしい。戦闘面でその強気を発揮してくれ。そら、おまえの剣だ」
登り際に置いていった剣を投げよこす。
pages.jaRuby:
「……え？ イリヤ、今の、どういう」

pages.en:
“…What? Illya, what do you mean by—?”

“I see. That is reassuring. Put that confidence to use in battle. Here—your sword.”

He tosses me the sword I left behind on the way up.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Eh? What does that mean, Illya?”
“I see, that is reliable. Please demonstrate that strong attitude during battles. Here’s your sword.”
He throws me the sword I left here.

pages.ja:
「っと……」
「走れるな。ここからは命がけだぞ」
話をしている余裕はない、と言峰は城門へ足を向ける。
それを咎めるかのように、
「」
何か異質な音が、冬の城を震わせた。

pages.en:
“Got it…”

“You can run, I trust. From here on, it is a matter of life and death.”

As if to say there is no time left for conversation, Kirei turns toward the castle gate.

As though rebuking him—

an alien sound shakes the winter castle.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Whoa…”
“You can run, right? Our lives depend on it now.”
Kotomine turns to the castle gate, telling me there’s no time to talk.
And in challenge to him…
“”
An odd sound shakes the winter castle.

pages.ja:
「……やっぱり。まだこの世に留めてたのね、サクラ」
今の咆哮は、間違いなく狩りの狼煙だった。
最凶の猟犬を放ったぞ、と。
親切で無慈悲な城の主が、逃げ惑う囚人に告げる死の宣告そのものだ。
pages.jaRuby:
「……やっぱり。まだこの世に留めてたのね、サクラ」

pages.en:
“…I knew it. You kept him bound to this world after all, Sakura.”

—That roar was unmistakably the signal that the hunt had begun.

The deadliest hound had been loosed.

It was the very sentence of death pronounced by the castle’s kindly, merciless mistress upon the prisoners fleeing her grounds.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I thought so. You kept him in this world, eh, Sakura?”
That roar was definitely a signal fire for the hunt.
Telling us that the most fearsome hound has been unleashed.
It’s like a death sentence placed upon a fleeing prisoner by an honorable, yet ruthless, lord.

pages.ja:
「
バーサーカーか」
「
」
思考が戦闘態勢に切り替わる。
バーサーカー、と。
かつて、いや今でも脅威の象徴である名を出され、細胞という細胞から余裕が搾り出されていく。

pages.en:
“—Berserker.”

“————”

My thoughts switch into combat mode.

Berserker.

At the name—once, no, still a symbol of terror—every scrap of composure is squeezed out of every cell in my body.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Berserker.”
“
”
My mind shifts into full alert.
Berserker.
I hear the name that embodies danger, and every last ounce of composure is squeezed from my body.

pages.ja:
「言峰」
「引くぞ。戦ってどうにかなる相手ではない。追いつかれれば殺されるだけだ」
言峰は先行して城門へ向かう。
pages.jaRuby:
「言峰」
「引くぞ。戦ってどうにかなる相手ではない。追いつかれれば殺されるだけだ」
言峰は先行して城門へ向かう。
pages.en:
“Kirei.”

“We retreat. He is not an opponent we can defeat by fighting. If he catches us, we will simply be killed.”

Kirei moves ahead, making for the castle gate.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Kotomine.”
“We’ll retreat. We can do nothing even if we fight him. We will be killed once he catches up to us.”
Kotomine leads the way to the castle gate.

pages.ja: 「振り返るなイリヤ……！ 諦めろ、バーサーカーは以前とは違う……！」
pages.jaRuby: 「振り返るなイリヤ……！ 諦めろ、バーサーカーは以前とは違う……！」
pages.en: “Don’t look back, Illya…! Let him go. Berserker isn’t what he used to be…!”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Don’t look back, Illya…! Forget about him, Berserker isn’t like before…!”

pages.ja:
イリヤの手を取って走り出す。
体力を温存している余裕なんてない。
追手が
俺たちを殺しに来るのがあの狂戦士なら、ここから森の出口まで最短の三時間を、全力で走り抜けるしか生き延びる術はない……！
pages.jaRuby:
イリヤの手を取って走り出す。

pages.en:
I take Illya’s hand and run.

—There is no room to conserve our strength.

If that mad warrior is the one coming to kill us, then our only hope of survival is to sprint the full three hours along the shortest route out of the forest…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I take Illya’s hand and start running.
We can’t be holding back now.
If that mad warrior is after us, the only way for us to survive is to run with all our might for the whole three hours to the forest’s edge…!

pages.ja:
息がつまる。
どんなに目を逸らしても無視できない闇が、すぐそこまで追ってくる。
pages.jaRuby:
息がつまる。
どんなに目を逸らしても無視できない闇が、すぐそこまで追ってくる。
pages.en:
—My breath catches.

A darkness I can’t ignore, no matter how hard I try to look away, is already closing in.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s hard to breathe.
A darkness I can’t ignore no matter what is overtaking us.

pages.ja:
「っ……！」
森を駆ける。
背後にはまだ何の姿も見えない。
聞こえるのは暴風の音だけだ。
追手は猟犬ではなく巨獣だった。
俺たちのように木々をすり抜けられない巨獣は、行く手を阻む木々を吹き飛ばしながら近づいてくる。
pages.jaRuby:
「っ……！」
森を駆ける。
背後にはまだ何の姿も見えない。
聞こえるのは暴風の音だけだ。
追手は猟犬ではなく巨獣だった。
俺たちのように木々をすり抜けられない[ruby text=ソレ o2o=1]巨獣は、行く手を阻む[ruby text=しょうがい char=2]木々を吹き飛ばしながら近づいてくる。
pages.en:
“—!”

I race through the forest.

There is still nothing visible behind us.

All I can hear is the roar of the gale.

Our pursuer is not a hound, but a colossal beast.

The thing cannot weave through the trees the way we can. It bears down on us by blasting aside every trunk that stands in its path.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……!”
I run through the forest.
I still don’t see anything behind us.
All I hear is the sound of raging wind.
The pursuer is not a hound, but a huge monster.
As he cannot slip in between trees like us, he instead follows by knocking aside whatever blocks his path.

pages.ja:
……トンネルを削る、巨大な削岩機に追われているような錯覚。
真っ黒い壁が少しずつ速度をあげ、俺たちを飲み込もうと突き進んでくるかのよう。
pages.jaRuby:
……トンネルを削る、巨大な削岩機に追われているような錯覚。
真っ黒い壁が少しずつ速度をあげ、俺たちを飲み込もうと突き進んでくるかのよう。
pages.en:
…It feels like being chased by some gigantic rock drill boring out a tunnel.

Like a pitch-black wall slowly gathering speed, surging forward to swallow us whole.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…It feels like we’re being chased by one of those heavy drills used for digging tunnels.
It’s like there’s a black wall bearing down to engulf us.

pages.ja:
「あ……はあ、は……だめ、そんなに速く走れない……！」
「っ」
pages.jaRuby:
「あ……はあ、は……だめ、そんなに速く走れない……！」
「っ」
pages.en:
“Ah… hah, hah… I can’t run that fast…!”

“—”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ah… haa, ha… no, I can’t run that fast…!”
“…!”

pages.ja:
歩を緩めてイリヤの速度にあわせる。
……まずい。
壁の速度と俺の速度はほぼ同じ。
イリヤを抱えて走れば、一分もしないうちに間違いなく追いつかれる
！

！
pages.en:

“That is what I told you. There is no need to concern yourself with me.”

—I lift Illya into my arms.

I can’t run the way Kirei did, but this is still faster than pulling her along by the hand…!

I can’t run as fast as Kotomine, but this is still faster than having her run with me…!

I turn my back on the priest.

The blackened roar comes from beyond the forest.

Still searching for our position, destroying everything at random as it comes, Berserker is steadily drawing closer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I turn my back to the priest.
The dark roar is coming from another part of the forest.
It’s surely coming closer while destroying everything in its path.

言峰にかける言葉なんてない。
背中を預けて、力の限り走り出す事が何よりの応えになる。
そうして、背を向けて地を蹴る寸前。

pages.en:
There’s nothing I can say to Kirei.

Entrusting him with my back and running with everything I have will answer him better than any words could.

—And then, just before I turn away and kick off the ground—
pages.mirrorMoon:
I have nothing to say to Kotomine.
Trusting him with my back and running with all speed will be my best reply.
And right when I’m about to start off…

The priest says something strange, his voice heavy with self-derision.

最後に見届けた背中が遠い。
……不吉な予感がする。
お互い生きたまま会う事は、もう二度とないだろうと思えたほどに。

—Two figures fall away behind us.

The last back I see is already far away.

…A terrible premonition grips me.

So strongly that I feel we will never meet again while both of us are alive.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Their shadows recede into the distance.
His back is so far away.
…I have a bad feeling.
I think we will never see each other alive again.
